description: Start a self-service agent registration: given the user's email and optional scopes, return a claim URL, a six-digit code and a claim token. The user opens the URL, signs in and approves scopes; the agent then polls /v1/oauth2/token with the claim token to receive a one-hour access token for the account MCP server. Use when the user wants to keep results, monitor a site, or read Search Console data (an audit result's nextActions links here). Creates a pending registration, no site changes.

email.description: The account owner's email (must match the account they sign in with)

name: visdenda_connect_account
title: Connect the user's Visdenda account
